sections.text_helper: Section 24.3 "OPAMP implementation" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 726.
sections.section_content:
The device has one OPAMP instance, OPAMP1. Table179 shows the pin and internal
signal specific naming, and provides the assignment to I/Os and the possible connection of
the internal signals:
• Generic name provides the pin and internal signal names as per Figure156.
• Instance-specific name provides pin and internal signal names pertaining to each
instance.
• Assignment or possible connection provides the assignment to I/O pins for signals on
pins (in upper-case letters), and the possible connections of internal signals (in lower-
case letters).
[Table 179. OPAMP pin and signal assignment per instance]
